channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tony Brothers | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tony Brothers from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Tony Brothers
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Anthony Edwards on the confrontation:

“Competition at the highest level. We want to win. Finchy want to win. Tony Brothers is Tony Brothers. We all love him.”

Anthony Edwards on Tony Brothers, May 9, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Kevin Huerter, Tony Brothers
item.description:
Billy Donovan on Tony Brothers’ interpretation of the play that saw Kevin Huerter ejected, as relayed to him:

“He felt like (Huerter's) intention was to smack the ball at the official.”

Billy Donovan on Kevin Huerter, Tony Brothers, Nov 21, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jeff Teague on Tony Brothers
item.description:
Jeff Teague:

“I was on the Hawks & we were playing the Pacers, my momma & my aunt were sitting courtside & cheering everytime I came in the game, then Tony Brothers pulled me to the side & he was like: Who them h*es?”

Jeff Teague on Tony Brothers, Apr 2, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Spencer Dinwiddie on Tony Brothers
item.description:
“What seemed to keep him (Brothers) irate, which was a clap, I think he thought was disrespectful,”

Spencer Dinwiddie on Tony Brothers, Nov 5, 2022. Source: FOXSports.com.

item.title: Trae Young on Tony Brothers
item.description:
Chris Kirschner:Trae Young:

“When Tony Brothers mentions to me how many years he's reffed in this league, I don't give a damn. That just gets fired me up. I don't think I'm emotionally drunk. I'm just competitive. It brings the best out of me and my teammates.”

Trae Young on Tony Brothers, Jan 30, 2022. Source: Twitter @ChrisKirschner.
